description.value: A very heavy pistol. It can't be concealed. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.
A cybernetical replacement arm. Comes with a free hand.

information.notes:
Homeless Veteran

Mook · Informant · 4th Corporate War veteran

A battered military jacket, an old cyberarm with faded patches. Sees everything that happens on the street.

Tactics: Stays out of other people's fights. If his friends get hurt, he shoots with an old gun.

HP 40 · Seriously Wounded 20 · Death Save 6

Made with the “Night City · Interactive Map” module. Art is up to you.
